title: DSA for Interviews
summary: The coding problems interviews keep asking, grouped by topic. Each topic opens with a primer: the technique, the words that point to it, a Swift template. Each problem gives starter code and tests to paste into Xcode or a playground, then — hidden until you have tried — the cue, the approach in plain words, a compiled and tested Swift solution, the Swift trap and the follow-ups. Blind 75 at its core, plus the problems German loops (Zalando, Sixt, Delivery Hero, N26) are documented asking.
